messages:
liam: Quick flag 1: the embeddings API reference still has a curl GET example that uses ?model=redwood-embed-small. The runtime now requires POST /v1/embeddings with JSON body {\"model\": ..., \"input\": ...}. That GET example triggers a 405 in new clients.

liam: Docs example currently:```bash
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=redwood-embed-small&input=hello%20world"
```

liam: Actual working request:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-small","input":"hello world"}'
```

asha: Ugh, that slipped through when we consolidated endpoints to POSTs for body validation. Good catch. Do you have a PR? We should update the cURL/Node/Python snippets and add a short note in the migration guide for anyone who copied the GET pattern.

liam: I started a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12701. It updates the API ref page, plus the quickstart snippets. Also added a one-liner migration note: "Note: embeddings requests now require a JSON POST body; query-string GETs are deprecated."

asha: Awesome. For Node snippet, please prefer the SDK example instead of raw fetch. Old Node example in docs used fetch with query params. Change to:```js
// new (sdk)
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'redwood-embed-small',
  input: 'hello world'
});
console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length);
```

liam: Done. I also left a fallback example for teams using raw HTTP clients, showing the POST with Content-Type. Kept the old GET example commented out with a deprecation note so the SEO snippets don't disappear abruptly.

dev-bot: lint/docs-check failed: snippet linter flagged double-quoted JSON in markdown fenced block. (file: api/embeddings.md line 42)

liam: Fixing linter now (escape quotes / use single ticks in fenced block). Will push a new commit.

asha: After linter pass, can you also add a tiny unit test in docs/spec that verifies the examples include "POST /v1/embeddings"? We had a regression where the GET snippet resurfaced from an older commit.

liam: Will add test. Also opened a support note draft to email customers who copied the GET curl snippet into integration scripts. Might be a handful.

staging-bot: Deployed docs/embeddings-post-update to staging at 1913456895 (sha: b12c3d4). Preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/api/embeddings

liam: Preview looks good. Examples render and the SDK snippet shows as recommended. Closing after the unit test merges. :white_check_mark:
